summary.sql: SELECT count(*) AS records, count(DISTINCT order_number) AS orders, count(DISTINCT product_mlfb) AS products, count(DISTINCT test_station_identifier) AS stations, count(*) FILTER (WHERE G0003 IS NOT NULL) AS code_present, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE G0003 IS NOT NULL) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS code_present_pct, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_last_measurement = false) AS non_last, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_last_measurement = false) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS non_last_pct FROM inspections WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order)

daily.sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('day', inspection_date) AS DATE) AS day, source, count(*) AS records FROM inspections WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY day, source ORDER BY day

by_station.sql: SELECT test_station_identifier AS station, count(*) AS records FROM inspections WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY station ORDER BY records DESC, station

top_products.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_label, i.product_mlfb) AS product, count(*) AS records FROM inspections i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_mlfb = p.product_mlfb WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(i.inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(i.inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR i.source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR i.test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR i.product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR i.order_number = $order) GROUP BY product), ranked AS (SELECT product, records, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY records DESC, product) AS rn FROM grouped) SELECT CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN product ELSE 'Other' END AS product, sum(records) AS records FROM ranked GROUP BY product ORDER BY records DESC, product

g0003_codes.sql: SELECT G0003 AS code, count(*) AS records FROM inspections WHERE G0003 IS NOT NULL AND ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY code ORDER BY records DESC, code

station_day.sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('day', inspection_date) AS DATE) AS day, test_station_identifier AS station, count(*) AS records FROM inspections WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY day, station ORDER BY day, station

recent_records.sql: SELECT inspection_date, order_number, product_mlfb, test_station_identifier, source, sequence_number, G0003, is_last_measurement FROM inspections WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) ORDER BY inspection_date DESC, order_number, sequence_number NULLS LAST
